questions.question: What should you do first when you see loose drywall pieces on the floor?
options: Pick them up or move them safely
Leave them for the next worker
questions.explanation: Loose material can cause slips and trips. Good housekeeping keeps the job site safer for everyone.

questions.category: A2 – Apply OHS Regulations and WorkSafeBC Standards
questions.question: Why are workplace safety rules important?
questions.explanation: Safety rules are designed to reduce hazards and protect workers. Every worker is responsible for following them.

questions.question: What does WHMIS help workers understand?
questions.explanation: WHMIS gives information about hazardous products. It helps workers read labels and safety data sheets.

questions.question: Which PPE protects your lungs from drywall dust?
questions.explanation: Drywall sanding produces fine dust. A respirator or dust mask helps stop dust from entering the lungs.

questions.question: What should you know before starting work in a building?
options: Emergency exits and fire extinguisher locations
questions.explanation: Knowing emergency exits and fire equipment helps workers respond quickly during emergencies.
